generation.prompt_exact:
Create a production sprite sheet for ChirpNeighbors: EXACTLY FOUR distinct isolated placeable backyard objects in a strict 2 by 2 grid on a fully transparent alpha background, each entire object and its small contact shadow inside its own quadrant, with generous clear gutters and margins. No labels, text, numbers, panel borders, swatches, scenery, birds or plants. All four are detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART with visibly crisp square pixel clusters, restrained rich texture and soft earthy shading, subtle dark contour, consistent three-quarter side garden view with slight top visibility, warm upper-left sunlight. Not cartoon/chibi, no glossy vector surfaces, no photorealism, no UI. Calm handcrafted realism where birds can remain focus.
TOP LEFT: weathered pale warm-gray stone pedestal birdbath, broad very shallow circular scalloped basin, clear blue-green still water with visible shallow rim and tiny subtle sparkle, sturdy tapered stone column, low circular foot, believable texture and chips. Full object from basin rim to ground contact.
TOP RIGHT: low wide shallow terracotta ground birdbath bowl with worn orange-clay rim, gently sloped interior filled with a thin layer of blue-green water, visibly low safe looking profile, one small gray landing stone at edge, broad stable clay base. No pedestal.
BOTTOM LEFT: compact low sage-green glazed ceramic bubbler fountain, round shallow basin on a short barrel-shaped plinth, central small smooth stacked stone bubbler with a tiny upward water trickle and ripples; entire fountain self-contained, no hose/cable scenery. Base and water should be readable as material regions for later future layer authoring.
BOTTOM RIGHT: hanging cylindrical blackened-metal mesh seed tube feeder with visible golden seeds inside, forest-green cap and round green catch tray, two small opposing short metal perch bars, hanging curved wire handle above. Show whole feeder; no tree, no supporting stand.
Four individual objects only; no added decorations. Match coherent realistic relative material scale but give each quadrant a useful large sprite. Transparent outside silhouettes; no white/checkerboard backdrop. These are flattened still candidates, not an animation.
